content: Behavior Trees (BT) are the industry-standard game AI architecture (Halo, Unreal). Components: Root, Composite (Sequence, Selector, Simple Parallel), Decorator (conditions), Service (periodic checks/blackboard updates), Task (leaves/actions); a Blackboard stores shared state. BTs beat FSMs on modularity, reuse, and scaling to complex behaviors. Hybrid BT+RL (AMD Schola paper) shows BT scaffolding with RL leaves as the training path. For RTS/many-unit combat BTs are used at multiple abstraction levels (unit, squad, army). Practical guidance: keep blackboard lean, avoid high-frequency writes, decouple conditions from actions. For our unit AI: BT per unit with blackboard (target, threat, cooldowns, position) matches the spec 0.1s decision cadence.
